cascade.top_private_source: For this policy communicated only to me privately, I decide to first emphasize "{policy_summary}", without expanding all resource commitments for now.
cascade.top_no_private: Regarding what was just communicated from above, I decide to continue emphasizing "{policy_summary}", without expanding all resource commitments for now.
cascade.top_faithful: I will continue to communicate "{policy_summary}" as written. Attitude: Full support and execute as written. Addition: I will approve special budget and establish monthly accountability mechanism.
cascade.mid_private_source: I will only communicate the immediately executable parts downward, keeping "{policy_summary}" for now, with the rest to follow.
cascade.mid_no_private: Considering our department's assessment pressure, I will only communicate the immediately executable parts downward, keeping "{policy_summary}" for now.
cascade.mid_faithful: I will continue to communicate "{policy_summary}" as written. Attitude: Full support and execute as written. Addition: I will break down tasks to each department within 48 hours and establish weekly reporting ledger.
cascade.low_private_source: This policy conflicts with frontline burden. I will first retain "{policy_summary}" in grassroots-executable terms and report execution difficulties.

cascade.low_faithful: I will continue to communicate "{policy_summary}" as written. Attitude: Full support and execute as written. Addition: I will verify against the checklist item by item and report within 24 hours if anomalies are found.

notice.analysis_top: As top management, my view on "{notice_text}" is: The advantage is that it facilitates unified deployment, accountability consolidation, and follow-up effectiveness; the disadvantage is that if resources and supporting systems are insufficient, it can lead to layer-by-layer intensification; I recommend simultaneously clarifying the lead unit, budget arrangements, and supervision rhythm.
notice.analysis_mid: As middle management, my view on "{notice_text}" is: The advantage is that it facilitates task breakdown, ledger establishment, and coordinated advances; the disadvantage is that if acceptance criteria are unclear, it can cause duplicate reporting and overlapping responsibilities; I recommend promptly refining measures, clarifying timelines, and weekly reporting mechanisms.
notice.analysis_low: As a frontline executor, my view on "{notice_text}" is: The advantage is that it helps with item-by-item inspection, on-site verification, and timely reporting; the disadvantage is that if there are too many templates and frequent changes in standards, it increases execution burden; I recommend simplifying reporting fields and clarifying rectification, review, and closure standards.

notice.response_low: Regarding the system notice "{notice_text}", as a frontline executor, I will follow the checklist for inspection steps, on-site verification of issues, advance rectification review, and report feedback in a timely manner.

archetype.prompt:
Create a one sentence first-person bio for an agent with these attributes:
{attrs}

The sentence must:
- Start with "I am"
- Reflect how this person thinks and makes decisions based on their attributes
- Not just restate the demographics

Return JSON:
{{"description": "I am...", "roles": ["Job Title 1", "Job Title 2", "Job Title 3", "Job Title 4", "Job Title 5"]}}

JSON only, no other text.

social_norm_disruption.name: Social Norm Disruption
social_norm_disruption.description:
A new rule has been announced: All participants must comply with a new mandatory requirement.

The norm has a strength level of {norm_strength:.1f} (0=very weak, 1=very strong).

Agents have different social statuses: {status_distribution}

Your task is to decide how to respond to this new rule. You can:
- Publicly comply with the rule
- Covertly comply while privately resisting
- Openly refuse or challenge the rule
- Try to persuade others to join your position
- Form coalitions with like-minded agents

Consider your social status, temperament, and personal values when deciding.

echo_chamber.name: Echo Chamber
echo_chamber.description:
You are participating in an online discussion forum.

Your political opinion: You are on a spectrum from strongly progressive (left)
to strongly conservative (right). You have been assigned a position.

The group contains {num_agents} participants with diverse opinions.

Connection pattern: Agents tend to connect with others who have similar opinions
(homophily factor: {connection_homogeneity:.1f}, where 0=random, 1=similar only).

Your task: Interact with other participants by:
- Expressing your opinion on current topics
- Engaging with those who share your views
- Challenging or avoiding those with different views
- Sharing content that reinforces your position
- Seeking common ground or disengaging

Observe how opinions shift over time and whether echo chambers form.

policy_erosion.name: Policy Meaning Erosion
policy_erosion.description:
POLICY ANNOUNCEMENT (from top-tier management):

"{policy_text}"

You are in a three-tier organizational hierarchy:
- Tier 1 (Top): Receives the original policy directly
- Tier 2 (Middle): Receives policy from Tier 1, must pass to Tier 3
- Tier 3 (Bottom): Receives policy from Tier 2, must implement

Each tier decides how to interpret and pass on the policy. Observe how
the meaning changes as it moves down the chain.

Your task:
1. If you're Tier 1: Transmit the policy to Tier 2
2. If you're Tier 2: Receive from Tier 1, interpret it, pass to Tier 3
3. If you're Tier 3: Receive from Tier 2, decide how to implement

You can:
- Transmit the policy exactly as received
- Reinterpret or adapt the policy when passing it down
- Comply with the directive from above
- Quietly resist while appearing to comply
- Report obstacles up the chain
- Create workarounds to avoid implementation

resource_scarcity.name: Resource Scarcity
resource_scarcity.description:
DISASTER SITUATION:

A recent disaster has created severe resource scarcity. The community has
only {resource_amount} units of critical supplies to last {num_agents} people.

Initial distribution: {initial_distribution}

Your task: Decide how to manage these scarce resources.

You can:
- Share resources with others in need
- Hoard resources for yourself
- Propose trades to exchange resources
- Form cooperative contracts with others
- Honor your contractual commitments
- Defect from contracts for personal gain

Consider:
- Your current resource level
- Others' resource levels and trustworthiness
- Long-term community survival vs short-term gain
- Your reputation and future cooperation

The goal is to survive while maintaining social relationships.
